problems:
The conclusion holds: as oracles the three give more than +0.01, but no realistic rule gets there. I re-read singles.json and combos_out.json and recomputed with the official summarise (scratchpad/combo/v_real1/check.py, check.log). Every headline number reproduces: base 0.93988 with divisions 25/31/74, best3 +0.00039, mid3 -0.00038, oracle_F +0.00629, Odiv +0.00541, joint F+L+Odiv +0.01353, joint with Ostrict +0.02711. The super-additivity explanation is correct and sits entirely in the division term. Joint adj-edge +0.00044 equals the sum of the singles (0.00027 + 0.00014 + 0.00003). Joint 0.1*divJ is +0.01309 (32/99) against 0.00602 (25/99) + 0.00538 (32/130), so super-additivity is +0.00169, from the shrinking Jaccard denominator. Errors and overselling:

(1) WRONG BREAK-EVEN. '~26.5%' is round 8's obsolete 0.265. On ins35 the break-even for adding a division is q* = J/(1+J) = 25/130 / (1 + 25/130) = 0.161, the number round 11 itself recorded. O res1.0, at 1 TP / 4 FP (20%), is ABOVE break-even: division 26/35/73 gives +0.00017, which is why that arm is positive. Res1.5, at 2/13 (13%), is below it. So for res1.0 the reason 'evaluable ones are at most 20% precise' is wrong. Its real limit is volume: 5 evaluable forks in 56 clips.

(2) THE REALISTIC NUMBER IS OVERSOLD, even as 'barely positive in-sample'. Its honest out-of-sample value is <= 0.
- Leave out 6bba_debd7bfa: best3 -0.00038, O res1.0 -0.00053. Leave out debd7bfa and cdcfe533 as well: best3 -0.00053. The sign flips on one clip, which is stronger than 'almost all of the gain'.
- Cross-embryo knob selection. Picked on 44b6: F = forkmid 3.5 (+0.00085 there), and O and L pick 'none'. Applied to 6bba that gives -0.00235. Picked on 6bba: fm4.5 / R8 / res1.0, which scores exactly 0.00000 on 44b6.
- Random half-split CV over clips (200 repeats, best grid point per family chosen on one half, scored on the other): mean -0.0013, 5th percentile -0.0044, 95th percentile 0.

(3) EMBRYO DOMINANCE. 44b6 is exactly 0 in every positive realistic arm (best3, FO, FL, LO, F fm4.5, O res1.0, L R8). All of the gain is 6bba (39 of 56 clips). The hidden test is 2 other embryos, so there is no evidence of any gain on a second embryo.

(4) MINOR.
- 'O res1.0: all from one clip' is loose. 4 clips change, W/L 2/2 (debd7bfa +0.026, ebdf3b34 +0.0023, 337b1b3a -0.0058, d1acb6ff -0.0014), so it is carried by one clip, not confined to one.
- The 'unannotated cells' sentence gives the wrong reason for the failure. Ignored edits are free (on the test set too). The rules fail because they make few evaluable edits and those are imprecise.

(5) TRANSFER framing is fine but understated.
- +0.00039/6 = +0.00007 public is correct arithmetic. Even at 1:1 transfer, +0.0004 is below the 0.001 public display step and 5x short of the +0.002 bar.
- Conversely, even the perfect joint oracle transfers at 1/6 to only +0.0023 public (+0.0034 with swaps), which is just over the R4 bar. So a perfect version of all three would barely clear it.
- R8 (a new mechanism with a lab gate, a dummy and a user OK by 27.09 12:00 UTC) is moot, because nothing realistic is positive out of sample.
corrected:
Answer to the user: yes as oracles, no in practice.
- Oracles: all three together with perfect decisions give +0.0135 lab. That is more than the sum 0.0118, because the division Jaccard compounds. With relink swaps it is +0.0206; with a perfect filter on the wide orphan pool, +0.0271. At the observed ~1/6 transfer that is ~+0.002 to +0.0045 public.
- Realistic: the best rules chosen in-sample give +0.00039 lab, entirely from 6bba (44b6 0.00000). Without the single clip 6bba_debd7bfa it is -0.00038. With honest knob selection it is <= 0: cross-embryo -0.00235 (chosen on 44b6) or 0.00000 (chosen on 6bba); random half-split CV mean -0.0013 [p5 -0.0044, p95 0]. The pre-declared setting gives -0.00038.
- Orphan-attach break-even is 16.1% (q* = J/(1+J) on 25/31/74), not 26.5%. Res1.0 (20%, 1 of 5) sits above it but has almost no volume; res1.5 (13%) and res3.0 (3.4%) are below it.
- Expected public gain of the combination: ~0 (<= +0.0001 even at full transfer of the in-sample number). The line stays closed; R8 is moot.
